author: Jeremy Jahns
description:
Sony announced January 2028 to be the end of physical discs on their consoles.....As an avid physical media collector, here are my thoughts.

Here are more eloquent thoughts on the matter from the great Jake Baldino: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0DN5xjVv_eo

#Sony #Playstation #PhysicalMedia
title: Sony NUKES The Future of Physical Media On Playstation...And it SUCKS!
